TITLE: Regular temporary residence permit extension | IND

Regular temporary residence permit extension
Last update: 11 September 2026
You want to extend your regular temporary residence permit (Type I) because it expires within 3 months. Find out what the requirements are and how to apply for extension.
Do you have a temporary asylum residence permit (Type III)? Then visit the web page
extend temporary asylum residence permit
.
Do you have a residence document verification against EU law for Union citizen family members? Then visit the web page
verification against EU law for Union citizen family members
.
Requirements
Process and costs
Application forms
See also
Do you have a temporary asylum residence permit (Type III)? Then visit the web page
extend temporary asylum residence permit
.
Do you have a residence document verification against EU law for Union citizen family members? Then visit the web page
verification against EU law for Union citizen family members
.
Requirements
You have a valid residence permit that you can still extend. You cannot extend the residence permits for the following residence purposes:
Working Holiday Program/Working Holiday Scheme
Cultural exchange
Au Pair
Stay as a trainee or student on work placement
Orientation year Netherlands
You still meet the requirements for your residence permit. For these requirements visit the web page about
the residence permit that you have
.
You have a valid passport or another travel document.
Your
main residence is in the Netherlands
. This means that you live in the Netherlands and spend most of your time there.
You are not a danger to public order or national security.
During the application for the residence permit you have now, you did not give any false information. And you did not withhold information.
Process and costs
These are the steps in the application process for the residence permit:
Show details
Hide details
1. Check requirements
A
valid provisional residence permit (MVV)
is needed for this application
Make sure you meet the
requirements
.
1. Check requirements
Make sure you meet the
requirements
.
2. Collect documents
The written application form lists which documents you need. Collect all documents before you apply. You can upload the documents in the online application.
Have official foreign documents
legalised and translated
into Dutch, English, French or  German.
2. Collect documents
The written application form lists which documents you need. Collect all documents before you apply. You can upload the documents in the online application.
Have official foreign documents
legalised and translated
into Dutch, English, French or German.
3. Apply
Will your residence permit expire within 3 months? Then you can apply for extension. You can submit the application online or in writing by post. You can usually apply for extension yourself. Do you have a residence permit as a highly skilled migrant, researcher or student in higher education? Then only your recognised sponsor can submit the application via the
Business Portal
.
Is your residence permit still valid for more than 3 months? Then you cannot yet submit an application to extend your stay. The IND is then unable to make a proper assessment.
Extend in time, prevent a residence gap
You should apply for the extension while your residence permit is still valid. Has the validity of your residence permit just expired? In that case, make sure that you submit the application no later than 4 weeks after the expiry of your residence permit. In this way you make sure that the residence permits succeed each other and you will not have a residence gap. If you have a residence gap, it will take longer before you can apply for a permanent residence permit or become a Dutch citizen.
Residence permit expired more than 4 weeks
Did your residence permit expire more than 4 weeks ago? Then you should apply for extension as soon as possible. You may have a residence gap. Make sure to include a letter in which you explain why you did not apply in time.
Residence permit expired more than 2 years
Did your residence permit expire 2 or more years ago? Then you can no longer apply for extension. You have to apply for a new residence permit. This means that you may also have to return to your own country to apply for a
Provisional Residence Permit (in Dutch: machtiging tot voorlopig verblijf or MVV)
.
4. Pay for application
You have to pay for the application. To find out how much your application costs, visit our web page
Fees: application costs
.
If you submit the application online you pay immediately via iDEAL | Wero. Have you applied in writing? Then you will receive a letter explaining how you can pay.
3. Wait for decision on application
The IND must take a decision within 90 days. This is called the decision period.
We can extend the decision period if it takes longer to decide. For example, because the application is not complete. In that case, the IND will send you a letter.
Do you also want to receive your post from the IND digitally? Register to receive mail in your message box (Berichtenbox) in
MijnOverheid
.
Follow the application in My IND
.
5. Wait for decision on application
The IND must take a decision within 90 days. This is called the decision period.
We can extend the decision period if it takes longer to decide. For example, because the application is not complete. In that case, the IND will send you a letter.
Do you also want to receive your post from the IND digitally? Register to receive mail in your message box (Berichtenbox) in
MijnOverheid
.
Follow the application in My IND
.
6. Decision on application
The decision will be positive or negative.
Positive decision: your residence permit will be extended.
Negative decision: your residence permit will not be extended. You will receive this decision in a letter. You can
object against this decision
.
7. Collect residence permit
When the residence permit is ready at an IND desk, you will receive a letter. You must make an appointment to collect it.
Make an appointment to collect the residence document
.
Application forms
You can submit this application online. You need to log in using DigiD. You can pay via iDEAL | Wero. Has your residence permit expired? Or were you unable to apply online? Then use the written application form which you sent to the IND by post.
Online application form for extension of your residence permit

Asian catering industry (Aziatische horeca)
Did the employee receive a permit after 1 January 2022 for the purpose of residence 'paid employment in Asian Catering Industry'? Then you cannot use this form. You apply for extension using the form Aanvraag verlenging verblijfsvergunning voor arbeidgerelateerde verblijfsdoelen GVVA (referent) 7047 (only available in Dutch).
